ambient_events: Bundled cables the thickness of your arm run the length of the vault, humming with stolen current.
A splice box sparks once, blue and sudden, then sulks.
The east wall is newer than the rest: poured concrete, sealed, deliberate.
description: A conduit vault where the power plant's buried feeders run in armoured bundles along the ceiling. Someone has tapped them: neat, competent splices bleeding off just enough current to matter, the kind of work the Watch are proud of. A sealed sublevel lies walled off to the east; the trunk carries on west and north.
name: Conduit Vault
